text: Very tasty! My bowl was great. The portion didn't seem very big at first look, but I was very full and couldn't finish it all so definitely plenty of food. I also really liked the Coconut Ginger Lime drink. A lot like a drink I had in Belize. Would be great with some rum.
Amazing food, service was impecable, beautiful ambiance.  Meticulous with details. The overall dining experience was heavenly.!

They have the worst customer service. And cant seem to follow simple requests. The only reason I gave them 2 starts is because I like their wings, even though they weren't extra crispy like I had asked. But after seeing some of the other reviews, they clearly get their customer service training from the owner.

After hearing very positive reviews of this place from friends, I was excited to give it a shot. This place is one of the newer installments to the International Plaza. 
The restaurant is trendy with artsy and crafty decor. There is a mixture of booth, table, and lounge seating to suit your social need. Yours eyes will inevitably be drawn to the wall of assorted whiskeys. Quite the collection .
I did not start my meal with drink so I can't speak to those, but the short ribs were good. The favors were fine but not mind blowing. The portions were small. I felt like I finished my meal in minutes. You will surely have room for dessert unless you start with an appetizer. The highlight of the night was the whiskey cake. It was amazing!! The portion is large enough for two people to share. I recommend it. 
Overall, I would go back. I'd like to try other things on the menu, including the cocktails.

I ordered from this restaurant twice but I did not receive my order both times. In those instances Curry Bird never answered when I called for an update nor called me with an update.  When I called the NEXT day to understand what happened, they refuse to offer any and hung up the phone when they discovered I called to complain.   They get a big ZERO from me because I will never deal with them again.

Friendly staff. Clean restaurant. Great for a date. Small & intimate.  I had spring rolls that weren't bad & I order combination fried rice, which was a bit disappointing. It only had 2 shrimp. Literally. I counted.

Best BBQ in town! Owner and staff are friendly. All around a great experience! Their bbq ribs and smoked brisket are delicious, not to mention all the delicious sides.
10/10 would recommend!

Delicious, spicy, great flavor profiles.

I ordered the vegetable fresh rolls, wonton soup and lamb (ground pork) salad. 

Wow. As one always hopes for with Thai food, the flavors danced on my palate and invigorated my senses. 

The fresh rolls were expertly rolled, rather large, and the veggies were balanced. The spicy sweet sauce was much better than many other restaurants which often tend toward a super sweet syrupy sauce. This one was tangy and of a thinner consistency. Loved them.

Wonton soup. I would not usually order a dish typically associated with Americanized Chinese food from a Thai restaurant, but boy am I glad I did. I was intrigued by the description on the menu which described a wonton soup with fish sauce, cilantro and bean sprouts...soundly very Thai-like in nature. It did not disappoint. The broth was delicate in flavor and complemented by the meaty chicken wontons. There was no doubt that this tasty soup was a Thai inspiration.

The larb salad was the highlight of the meal. Fresh and crisp cabbage, thinly sliced red onion, crunchy peanuts and sliced green onion balanced with the ground pork, fish sauce and lime juice to make one of the best larb salads I've had the pleasure of eating. I enjoyed being able to get it Thai hot, and it was that. Not overly seasoned, but a balanced spice to still bring out the key flavors of the dish.

All at a reasonable price point: $4 rolls, $8 salad and $4 soup.

I will definitely be ordering from here again.

(I was super

Great tacos and other food is delicious! It is on a busy street and a busy restaurant for a reason. The corn tortillas add to the authenticity and flavor of the food. I ordered the Three Piggies Burrito and it was huge but delicious. My family all ordered tacos and loved them. There is a bit of spice in all the food but it is mild in comparing to other spots. The waitress/bartender was great and helpful. As soon as a drink was low she filled it up. There is a step down to get to the bathroom and mainly high top tables.

Very unassuming from the outside. But once inside it opens up to an nice dining area deprecate from the bar area with lovely art framings and pleasant atmosphere. Our waitress was very friendly and patient. And the food was really good. Lobster bisque was a bit salty. Hummus delish but the veggies that came with it lacked presentation. The bbq Smokey taste of the chicken was mouthwateringly good. The mashed potatoes were like mamas. With a few nice lumps to let you know it's real.

Ordered takeout on Saturday night. My pick up time was for 7:15. We were extremely happy with the service and everything was included. The food was warm but my overall experience was great. I highly recommend Olive Garden. 
Gloria

I can see why this store only has 2 stars. The staff was rude as hell. They talk to you, almost whispering, and show they are annoyed when you repeatedly ask "what was that?" Because you can't hear them. Also, the blonde girl at the toppings section was just as rude and quiet.
@ the manager: please rethink your staff choices.
Ok I get that you make this fresh but 20 min waiting in the drive thru is insane... don't have a drive thru. Would give zero.. so mad

This was a gem of an experience on a rather ordinary weekday. The value of the happy hour cannot be beat.  We had delicious cocktails and wine, and a smattering of appetizers, all of which were extraordinary. Of special note were the baby artichokes. The entire staff (especially our waiter Nicholas) were friendly, engaging, and took care of us very well. Someone in our party accidentally left her purse, and they kept it safe for us at the host stand until we were able to return.  We have lived in Reno for 16 years, and kept asking ourselves why we don't come here more often.
Delicious food and drinks! Love the atmosphere! The staff was amazing! Must try the sweet potato fries

Because this place is so tiny and tucked away off the main street of Brandon Blvd, I have been hesitant to stop by a try in case the food was mediocre.  The reviews on Yelp were so-so with big kudos to "stay aways". The pictures of the food and raves over the ice cream wore me down so today I took a chance to try it for the first time and I am so glad I did. 

I placed my order via the drive-thru so I wouldn't have to sit outside on a bench and wait. Early evening at this time, cloudy with thunder in the distance. I was greeted immediately, very friendly sounding voice. 
I ordered a chili cheese hot dog, a large order of onion rings, and a brownie sundae with no peanuts. After paying at the window, I was asked to pull over and my food would be brought out. It wasn't a long wait at all and again the server who brought my food to me was friendly.  After confirming several times that no beans were in the chili *yuck* and that no peanuts were in my sundae, I took my food home to roll out and enjoy.

The hot dog was so plump and tender that I closed my eyes when savoring that first full bite. The bun was soft, but not soggy and the chili taste was just right. Not one bean in sight so I was so happy! My brownie sundae was also prepared as asked, no peanuts. BTW, I'm not allergic to peanuts, I just don't like them.  The onion rings, oh those onion rings. I absolutely love a good onion ring. I crave good onion rings. These onion rings are fantastic!  They have the delicious crunchy h

Let's just put it this way, this is the owner of your favorite taco spot's favorite taco spot. When your out of town friends ask you about a dope taco spot, this is where you should take them. They will thank you and ask you to go back every time they visit. Just make sure you have good timing. This spot is only open three days out of the week and they don't go until they close, they go until they sell out.
Hands down, best sandwiches around. Their spicy honey is ridiculously good! French fries are delish! And although the food is "fried" it's not heavy and is so fresh!

We have been here a few times now and everytime the experience has been great. I use the Yelp app to put us in line before we arrive so our wait isn't too long. The staff is always friendly and courtious. I recommend the Bananas Fosters pancakes and my wife says the shrimp and grits are to die for. If you are coming in a group bigger than four definitely use the app because they are always busy and you may end up waiting over an hour. Great place for coffee, but they also have bloody Mary's and Mimosa if you're looking for a drink.

If you go to Hooters expecting fast service, you're wrong. If you go to Hooters expecting hot food, you might get lucky. If you want a cold beverage quickly, probably shouldn't go here.
BUT, it's Hooters. Our food was piping hot, our drinks were strong, and we got seated right away. We didn't have a server for 20 minutes, but I could look past that. 
Go here with lower expectations and you'll leave happy!
Great place awesome staff- inexpensive and large portions is a St. Louis must the owners also have a pizza place behind it that has excellent pizza!

If I could give more than 5 Stars, I would! This past weekend we had a very large rehearsal dinner (60 people) and welcome reception party (about 150 people) following the dinner. And, this was the best food, service, New Orleans venue and accommodations ever. Right from the friendly and convenient valet, to the extraordinary service, to the amazing food, and coordinating all the logistics... I can say enough about how great our experience was at the Jack Rose. Even our guests staying at the hotel - enjoyed their entire experience! Laura, was wonderful in ensuring every detail was addressed, helped us pick the perfect menu, and ensured all our guests received the 5-Star experience we were hoping for. Also, I have never had such great food when being served for so many people - crab bisque soup ...awesome! and filets and shrimp were perfectly done and artistically presented! Far exceeded what I could have imagined!

So delicious and a great Italian meal. I went to the one in Oliver and it was very good prompt service. This was before Covid so I'm not sure the situation now. 

I dare say it's better than a lot of VERY POPULAR Italian restaurants. The server told me why my meal was special, where it was from and how the ingredients worked together... which is what I like when I'm dropping North of $20/plate. Tell me why this meal is better than Old Spaghetti Factory (which is amazing too)

Excellent.

The employees I dealt with today were extremely unprofessional and rude and impatient. The first girl who helped me seemed very out of it. The other older woman was extremely pissy with me and rude when I thought she put mustard on the wrong sandwich and basically gave me a look like "well what do you want me to do about it?" Hey lady, it's a piece of bread, it's not the end of the world. But go ahead and throw a fit about it because that's professional. I worked at a bakery for over 3 years and had to deal with the worst customers and always did it with a smile on my face and friendly attitude. I could definitely tell she was annoyed and fed up with me and it made me feel very uncomfortable. Also the last time I came here and ordered online to pick up, I had to wait about 10 minutes for my prepaid order before this same woman acknowledged me and the man standing in front of me who had been waiting longer than I had. I don't think I will be coming back.

this mcdonald's is by far the worst i've ever been to, i'd recommend staying away from here unless your only other option is dog food.
rude employees, no drive through organization, food slopped together, and often the wrong order
entirely, making the drive through and employee interactions a bigger nightmare the second time around.
for a time, had the misprivilege of living just a few houses behind this place and often had to listen to yelling from angry customers but what's worse is i've listened to some of the high school employees remarks and they're just as unprofessional if not worse.
from my understanding the drive through is supposed to be 24 hours but there have been times the employees turn all the lights off and act like no ones home.
i understand staff if probably trying their best with the covid thing, but these experiences and complaints stem from over the course of years before hand with little change.
i would have thought the remodeling of the building would have brought new employment and made things better but it hasn't... 
it's been getting worse.
and in fact this restaurant is so bad that it's the soul reason i've downloaded the yelp app.
new leadership needs to be emplaced and the current employees i would imagine need an adjustment in training, attitude, and probably the pay they're "earning" as well.
Excellent service and food was delicious . Love Kurtiss efficiency and customer service. Clean and In quaint location.

Of course, my honest opinion here. I haven't been back to this spot for many years because there are just so many other places I would rather eat. 
We wanted to try another steak place since we have pretty much tried them all. The last time I was here, I ordered fish. Yeah yeah, I know. Why would I order fish in a steak restaurant. Well, I just wasn't in a steak mood at that time I guess. 
When we sat down, our server came over pretty quickly. His name was Chris. I have to say that just on his service alone, HE deserved a 5 rating. My wine glass was a bit dirty and he apologized and went back to the bar for a new glass of wine. 
When we ordered, he made sure he paid close attention to how we ordered our food. How do I know? I asked about the asparagus being cooked in butter or oil be because I didn't want any, and when my Filet Mignon came, he made sure not to have the butter on top of my steak. I didn't even have to ask. 
I was very impressed. It's the attention to detail that a lot of servers miss. Anyways, as you guessed it, I had the Filet and my friend had the Bone In Ribeye. They were both just ok. Even though I had mine cooked MR, I missed the juice from the steak. These were cooked over a wood fire grill which gave the steaks their "woodsy" taste. My filet wasn't the best. It seemed a bit dry? Eh, not for me. 
Other than that, their Gator bites, side salad, and table bread were good. I don't think I would come back and have dinner here. I think it's a bit over priced

This place has a really chill vibe, definitely a place you would want to work, but the menu needs more of a variety. I would come again but it's not really somewhere that you can enjoy multiple times.

I give Taquitos 5 stars only because I'm not allowed to give them 10.  This place has outstanding food (tacos of various kinds, quesadillas, burritos, salads, etc), uncommonly good service and a family atmosphere.  We eat here about once a week, and we always feel welcomed and appreciated.  There's just nothing NOT to love about Taquitos Mexican!

Sauce is a regular staple of mine when I am in the Tucson area. Try the lasagna but arrive early because they run out! Staff friendly and Mondays are especially nice because if you are military or EMT or cop, you get 20% off! Too bad cops get this discount

Kept seeing their Papajama on TV, final went to get one. After I got there found out their are many different kinds. Ordered the one that sounded like the one in the ad. It was good except in the ad it says; cheese, cheese is what holds it together. Well, I couldn't find any cheese. But it was good, and would get another.

The food is delicious. The service is reliably slow and unfriendly. I think they are always understaffed. The one or two ppl working seem bothered if you ask for condiments that aren't outside. Due to the poor service, my last visit is probably my final visit.

My favorite restaurant in Saint Pete !!! Beautiful place for Brunch, Dinner or Lunch. Glad we have Library. If you don't know where to take your family to eat, take them to Library. Won't regret !!! And coffee is absolutely the best !!!

So normally, I love it here. Today I got a cold waffle and burned bacon. It was truly inedible so I had to send it back. Then I received a redo. That's what these pictures are. The new food. Really!? I know you can do better. Would've been 1 star but my coffee is good and I like it here.

This food shouldn't have been served. It's easy to see! The kitchen staff, the server, shouldn't have put this out!

My friends and I Stopped in to Crescent City Brewhouse for a drink on the cutest back patio. There's a fountain and an Instagram-worthy pink wall. Our server was super polite and on top of our drink orders so that was appreciated. I was a little surprised at my Absolut and soda ringing in at $11 but it was a relaxing time spent together with friends in a beautiful courtyard. We didn't have any food but everything we saw looked great. I would come here again to try some food!

A last minute decision for ice cream brought me to the Dairy Queen drive thru. This location was about a mile from my hotel. The drive thru was very busy and we had to wait a few minutes to order, but overall not a bad experience. 

I got a small cookie dough blizzard and this is one of the best that I've had. So much cookie dough, not too much chocolate sauce mixes into the ice cream. It hit the spot.

We enjoyed our dinner so much the first night that we returned 2 nights later! The food was perfectly cooked and deliciously seasoned, matched by excellent cocktails. Service was friendly and responsive. Beautiful decor and high energy ambience without being unbearably loud.

We may have had too high of expectations for this restaurant, but left feeling a little underwhelmed. Our drinks and appetizers were good (get the nachos), but our mains were nothing special and the fish tacos were boring, actually. Treat this as a happy hour spot and not a speciality dinner night.

We have been wanting to visit for a while and finally got a chance to go for lunch. We arrived at 11am and was seated immediately in a comfy booth at the bar. Lots of natural light and cool, modern decor. I had the steakhouse salad, which came with two deviled eggs, avocado, blue cheese crumbles, thick bacon pieces and lemon-horseradish vinaigrette - it was AMAZING. The steak was cooked to order and had a wonderful flavor. I love a good salad and almost always order one for lunch outings, and this will be on my short list of fave salads.  My husband ordered the Shaved Prime Steak, which was really good, but he had also wished he'd gotten the salad! Will recommend and return.

Was really craving Pad Thai and found this spot on Yelp so decided to give it a try.  It was about 45mins prior to their closing so we placed the order online and headed right over to pick it up.

The restaurant is off the side of a main road, and is very easy to drive right by if you're not paying attention -- so be attentive and slow down early.

There are about three parking spots in front and a few more to the left of the building.  Due to COVID they are only doing take out and delivery, with the option of eating your food on one of their outside bench tables, with an umbrella to help block the sun.

I ordered a tofu and shrimp pad thai which came out to be about $14.  The portion size here is definitely for a family as the pad thai lasted me for 4 meals!  The Thai Hot was spicy and had good flavor but I feel it completely took away from the other flavors pad thai should have; e.g. tamarind.  Nonetheless the pad thai was great here and I would definitely order it again.

The following day, because the pad thai was so good, I wanted to try something else on their menu.  So I ordered the drunken noodles with chicken in medium this time.  Same deal here with the portion size, although this one lasted me only 3 meals -- thinking it was the extra protein that allows for an extra meal.  The flavor was great, but the heat for medium was not hot enough, so thinking next time I'll try their hot (in between medium and Thai hot).

If you're in the area and craving Thai food, so far,

The staff is friendly, masks are worn properly, and the tables are socially distanced. They offer dine-in and takeout. 

This used to be a hotpot place, so they either overhauled their menu or they're under new management. 

Portions are large and family-style (with the exception of noodle soups, which typically aren't).

The soft shell crab dish (~$18) was perfectly fried small delicate pieces of crab. They also included two bowls of white rice, which was unexpected-- I had to remember that we were in Philly (in NYC they'll charge you for rice).

We also ordered seafood egg noodle soup (pictured). This wasn't my order so my only opinion was that it was a fair-sized portion with a fair variety of add-ins. 

Not pictured was an order of chow fun (broad rice noodles, also called drunken noodle in other places). It was packaged with extra consideration-- the sauce was in a separate container from the noodles to prevent sogginess.

Also not pictured was their salted fried rice dish. On our way out, we overheard a family of 5 ordering 5 dishes for takeout.. With this tipoff, I felt that I had to do the same, and I ordered two to go-- this was a good decision, and now I can recommend this dish as well.

Every once in a while, you walk into a restaurant and know it will be a most satisfying experience. Guests looked happy to be there and smiled while eating their brunch. Food was yummy and satisfying. We're glad we walked in and will definitely be back even though we're from Ohio.
Like everything at Sweet Box, the cheesecake bar are delicious!  Great texture and consistency. The crust is so buttery.  Great job, Sweet Box!

True diner / diner food. Unfortunately we came right after a breakfast rush and our table wasn't the cleanest, but I think they were just unprepared for the rush. Their menus definitely could've used a wipe down - it was less than appetizing. The food, however, came in generous portion sizes. Slightly on the pricey side for diner food but you definitely get your money's worth for it. La Colombe coffee + free refills were a nice perk! Will come back for convenience and hope we catch them at a better time

We went here about a month ago and we were promptly greeted. The staff was friendly and helpful. 
Our food was pretty good and we plan on going back. 
I loved how extensive the menu was and the samosas were spot on.

Beautiful ambiance. Got here for the early bird dinner. $30 for full course meal! Plus the martini specials from the lounge apply in the restaurant. They even give you a hot towel at the end of your meal. My server Cooper was cheerful and fast. I appreciate him alot.

The first thing that hits you when you walk in are the magnificent smells that tells you This is a bakery!
I was looking for simple, coffee and a danish.  I got the coffee but picked a pecan cinnamon roll.  Lots of nuts not overly sweet with a not too heavy dough.  Very Good!!!!

Just wanted average sushi. We got that average sushi but it is over priced. Our fried shrimp roll only had 4 pieces one of which was all unpeeled shrimp tail, the miso soup was cold, they didn't include the eel sauce that cost a dollar to add, and the 3 dollar side salad. So if you want 10 pieces of average sushi and some cold miso soup for $34- this place is for you!!
The food was pretty good but a bit overpriced for pizza and chopped cheese. The parking for this establishment is horrible.
Excellent food & outstanding service. The best steakhouse I have ever been to. The ribeye was incredible and the crab cakes were to die for.

Pizza was delicious. Love how big and filling the slices are. Only problem was the seating. Oh man it made me so mad! The first come, first serve system is bullshit! My family of 5 waited for 25 minutes for a table because every time we went to grab a table someone else took it. For a restaurant that busy AND that small, there needs to be a better seating system!

This place is amazing! The food the employees are fantastic!  Never been to a Portillo's till now and let me tell you the Italian beef sandwiches are ON point! Also loved the hotdogs. But the Italian beef sandwich dipped was incredible! The employees were very helpful and knowledgeable about the food.  Not your normal fast food employees.  It's not fine dining but it's amazing for what it is!

Best pizza ever. Was visiting from out of state and let me tell you this pizza is the bomb! I ordered a mondo sized pizza and ate the whole thing it was too good not to! Can't wait to come back and have another delicious mondo pizza with pepperoni, cheese, jalapeños and pineapples!  oh so good praise the Lord of glory!

Got there late afternoon.  Line was short.  Food was okay.  I love a good diner but it looked and tasted like it was sitting around all day.  Ham was insanely salty.   Good place to visit if you like historical places to check off your list.  But if you want good food it was okay

I placed a take out order for my daughter and myself today through uber eats. It was our first time trying out this place.

After we picked up the food we drove a little while and noticed that there are missing two soup bowls that is supposed to come with this food, so I called this place. The staff who handed the food to me said if we come back now they will give the soup. We already drove 15 minutes away and almost got home, so couldn't go back. I said we are a little too far away and maybe we could get it next time when we order their food again. It literally was a casual talk before I hang up. However, his returning answer was "I am not sure because I don't know when you are coming back. If I am not here I have to write a note to someone and they might not see it blah blah... " 

Wow!!!

He could be a little more flexible dealing with their customers especially when it is on their fault. "Sure, I am sorry." That's all it takes to pass this episode. The missing soup was not a big deal but the staff attitude was quite a surprise considering the given circumstance. 

My over all first time experience with this bob cafe was not that great as I wished. The food was okay though.

I gave in last night after so many other disappointing Jamaican spots in Philly and I'm pleased to say it was really good. We ordered a Large oxtail and large fish platter both with white rice and corn. The oxtail was a little bit fatty but the flavor and spice was great. The fish had a weird chemical smell so we didn't eat the fish at all. The large oxtail was $17 the box looked more like a medium but thank goodness it actually taste good this time. Call ahead the line gets very long

It's a good Mexican restaurant. If I lived in the area and knew when to come to avoid a long wait for a table, then I'd probably be a regular. It's not superb or the pinnacle of Mexican cuisine, but it's good.

I ordered the Chimichanga with Carne Seca which they're supposed to be famous for, but I was served chicken instead. Huge let down. Unfortunately, we didn't have time to have them to correct it. 

Service was just okay. Nobody seemed especially enthusiastic or energetic. Just a bunch of wait staff and hosts doing the bare minimum with half-hearted smiles.

I'll hopefully get a chance to try the place (and their Carne Seca) again someday.

I really wanted to enjoy my Ramen, but there was no meat in my food. I specifically ordered duck, because it is a delicacy and is often cooked poorly. The meat in the duck Ramen was okay, but the serving was way to small for the price. The duck was a very thin sliver of meat.

I had edamame as an appetizer and that was exactly how it should be served. The soy sauce on the table has a bit of spur to it. I did not try the sushi but if I go back, I will try it. This was an ok/average meal.

Went tonight to Union Public House for my birthday (it was on Wednesday, as I am now an indescribably old lady of 42). We did have to wait to be seated, which was fine. I always carry a book in case of emergencies, like if someone tries to talk to me. If you are also an introvert, highly recommended. (5 out of 5 stars.) 

We were seated, depending on your POV, either in front of or behind a very rowdy group of girls in their early twenties. One received an impromptu lap dance from a friend. Little awkward, just saying. 

We started with the mason jar. House made pickles and veggies, yum. DH had Johnnie Walker Black (reasonably priced at $10) to start. The cocktails sounded delicious, but I didn't feel like drinking tonight. Next time I'll probably have one of the mules, though. There are a ton of different kinds and they all sound terrific. 

The mason jar was delicious. I was leaning pretty strongly towards a heavy dinner, so a light and delicious starter sounded good. (I would have happily tried the cauliflower, hummus, pretzels or bread and butter as well.) I was extremely excited when I found a great big pickle at the bottom of the jar. 

***IT WAS A JALAPENO AND NOW I KNOW EXACTLY HOW HOMER SIMPSON FELT AFTER EATING THAT BRAZILIAN INSANITY PEPPER. I did *not* see any coyotes that sounded like Johnny Cash, did not wake up on a golf course, and also didn't climb any weird pyramids or kick a spiteful turtle***

I had a few options for what I wanted to eat tonight. I had gon

It took 12 years to find a Chinese restaurant that we could even tolerate in the Treasure Valley. There were a few ok options, and lots of bad ones. We discovered Red Pavilion last year when we moved locations and have been mostly happy with it. 

I have oddly never dined in here. I have only eaten take out because of "Hungry" and "Hurricane". But one day, I WILL enjoy their modern decor and can maybe comment on the service. 

I have liked everything that I have eaten here. My favorite is the Mandarin Chicken and the Chow Mein. I think my Chinese preferences are pretty vanilla. I always get the big dinner combo, because I can get the cream cheese wonton appetizer (and then eat them in the car on the way home and tell my husband that the restaurant must have forgotten to pack them) and "Hungry" can eat my soup and half my entree (Seriously. She's 4). Hubs likes the Kung Pao Chicken and Honey Almond Shrimp. I have to sneak a bite when he isn't looking, because deep down he knows I ate the wontons and doesn't want to share. But my quick bites have been delicious. :) Overall, it is a good option in the Valley.

The two stars are for the wait staff's friendliness and the ability to customize the menu items. 

I walked into First Watch and was immediately taken back by the noise level. I understand people were chatting and enjoying their meal. What I don't understand is how First Watch allowed for a configuration that doesn't reduce the noise. My Sound Print app reported it was "very loud! Long exposure can cause hearing loss". OSHA has regulations regarding noise levels and the employees are working in an environment that will damage their hearing. 

The Monterey Club was good. Fresh greens, good turkey and avocados. The potatoes were too salty. Service was prompt and the waitress was helpful and friendly. 

Will I try another First Watch, probably, but if it has high levels of sound like Newtown Square, then it gets crossed off my list and off the list of recommended places to eat for my office.
nice little sushi place. i enjoyed my miso soup and rainbow roll. recommended sushi. friendly staff and good prices

The food was good, the service was excellent, But there was absolutely no social distancing at all!!  I do not understand why some restaurants go to the expense of putting up plexiglass between tables and spacing tables out and some do not!!!  PF Chang's is one that appears to have done nothing but require their employees to wear masks.
Best PadThai in Clearwater, perfect for spice lovers! Amazing Udon and Ramen. This place is so good that we came three nights in row. Looking forward to come back to try other dishes.
The food is fantastic, everything I've tried has been great. Madras curry is awesome, the biryani is great! Highly recommend

Our family decided to go there for dinner; we had not been to that location for a few months. There were no other customers, yet we waited an hour for our dinners after ordering. The Everything Breakfast was missing half the ingredients shown in the menu photo. Waitress had to take it back to the cook. My 15-year old great nephew had ordered the chicken fried steak, and the waitress did not tell us they were out of it until she brought out everyone else's orders. He ordered something else and did not get his dinner until we were almost finished. My nephew's wife ordered a hamburger with everything but cheese, and the waitress brought her a plain hamburger with nothing on it. My sister had to wait 30 minutes for maple syrup for her pancakes and never got a refill on her coffee. We told the manager about my great nephew's not getting a dinner for over an hour, and she did not bother to take his dinner off the bill. We will never go back there. Portions small, do not look like the menu photos, and apparently the cook had no idea how to prepare the food.

Foods not bad here 

I ordered prettty much your general tsos chicken and sushi and thought everything tasted great

Ordered unicorn, dancing eel, salmon twin, volcano and passion roll along with the 3 rolls of eel avocado, white tuna and shrimp tempura rolls, all were leg

the hunan combo and the beef ho fun we're OK,
I'd stick with the basics here

Recommend if you live by the neighborhood

OK guys I'm usually not this person, I only leave five star reviews unless an experience is so bad I have to share it with everybody. this is not the first time that I've gotten an order like this it seems like the meat portion is getting smaller the tacos aren't as crispy and the parm is not what I remember. the one shown in the picture is without lettuce. The kid Also through some taco sauce from Casa soLana now if I would've known that he was gonna throw in some casa soLana I would've said no thank I'll just get the house salsa. I know that due to the pandemic they are having trouble filling orders for their Jimboy's sauce but at least tell me that you're out of your house sauce and you're going to give me prison sauce. Now did I eat the tacos? yes, yes I did but it's because I just got off of a long hard day at work did not look in the bag because I trusted everything would be in there and when I got home I was disappointed. Being In the food service industry myself I know how much it means to people to be able to go out again. I know how important it is to get the order correct the first time. I know how much you should appreciate big orders or people that are supporting your business through these times. Anyway hope all gets better and we all make it through. Cheers.
If you're looking for Pub food, stop by. Nothing spectacular. Nice staff. My food was great.

Delicious dinner last night at Antica BYOB. Every did was amazing. For appetizers we shared the meatballs w ricotta, the polenta w Gorgonzola, artichokes, sautéed onions & the grilled octopus w arugula . Entrees we had were the Pork Cheeks w Portobello mushrooms w grilled polenta, short rib spinach fettuccini, chicken w crab w tomatoes & spinach, gnocchi w Gorgonzola cream sauce ( very rich) I have had the Gnocchi in pesto sauce,  Tagliatelle alla Bosciala w fava beans, different mushrooms, pancetta. You can't go wrong w any entree. Everything was awesome. For dessert we shared the pistachio chocolate bread pudding w ice cream & a tiramisu. Complementary house made limoncello after the meal is terrific.  BYOB w no corkage fee!!!! We love everything about Antica.

Avoid at all costs. Gave it three tries and the third was the last test on my nerves. My husband loves this place he can be an odd duck at times he's picky, but likes hole in the walls too. Cal Neva Reno is known for reasonably priced everything. The first two times were somewhat bearable. The third time was three years ago and the absolute last. I worked a full day of deep tissue massage at my office and was starving. Had a fast break and had half of my meatball sandwich from subway wrapped in my purse and forgot about it(this leads somewhere). Joey was like let's go to Cal Neva's Top Deck Restaurant I reluctantly agreed and so sure. We waited twenty minutes which was okay. We were seated and that was fine good booth. Our waitress was either having a bad day or just didn't want to be there. She barely greeted us and was pissed off when she did. I was nice and ordered chicken noodle soup and a Greek chicken wrap sounded safe. I am soooooo glad I still had that sandwich. The soup came just a small bowl which she practically slammed on the table. It was the most tasteless soup I'd ever had. I actually took out the sandwich and put it in the soup and asked for some croutons she gave me an evil look.  The chicken wrap I ordered  was okay until I was about to take a second bite. Stopped and yes this is gross a long hair was in it. I showed Joey got up and walked out. His meal was good according to him. Will never go back again. The service abhorrent the food even worse. Run!

We went for the lunch buffet today - a Saturday - and had to wait briefly before we got seated. It was crowded with mainly Indian clientale which is always a good sign when one goes to an Indian restaurant.

The food was very good - really authentic tasting cuisine and decidedly South Indian - Chennai style. The authenticity extended to the general chaos in terms of trying to replenish the fast dwindling dishes in the buffet which even extended to being out of silverware. Sort of reminded me of what it is like when one eats at a moderately priced restaurant in India.

They were short staffed and the two individuals I saw helping out did their best to cater to the crowded restaurant.

The food is spicy as one would expect given the regional cuisine that it represents. I compliment the management in not modifying the cuisine to suit western or north Indian taste. The food is somewhat spicy though I suspect most westerners and those from other parts of India would find the food to be too spicy for their taste ...... but there are plenty of other Indian restaurants in the Tampa areas that provides more bland food.

I withheld a star because of the somewhat chaotic atmosphere - we had to wait a while for silverware and the bowls for daal etc were styrofoam!

So in summary: five stars for the food and 3 stars for the somewhat chaotic organization and service.

When I want sushi, I order delivery from here. Staff was always nice, in person, and food is good. Now, delivery comes pretty quick, and I'm always happy with my order. Give it a try, next time you want sushi.

Waited an extra 30 minutes in the lobby after the order was ready for pickup as they kept forgetting to send it out. When I finally got the cheesesteak (with provolone, mushrooms, and hot peppers), the meat tasted bland and needed salt. The bread was fine, as were the portions. 
Maybe it was just an off day as there seemed to be a lot of regulars in there, but between the service and the food I don't think i would go back.
We had a wonderful experience. Scallops, Brussels sprouts, avocado toast, mushroom bisque. Even with stupid lockdown rules, Seasons 52 is making it work. Our server Gwen is a rockstar.

We are in town for business and came across this gem!   I have eaten at many Greek influenced breakfast places and most always enjoy them but this was in a class all it's own.  The food was prepared perfectly!  I had the huevos rancheros and the churizo was the best I have ever had.  My partner had the spinach bacon and tomato eggs Benedict and the sauce was to die for.  Wait staff was attentive and nice.  The owner was a super sweet woman who obviously loves her business and employees.  We will definitely be back!

It's a Florida-based chain, but feels more like a local place.  Great food, and the specials are always awesome.  Try the crab cakes benedict or the huevos rancheros for breakfast!  They also have great lunch and dinner items... try the fried chicken sandwich for lunch or the "Pulled Pork Mac Stack" for dinner.  Also, their sweet tea is excellent, and they have good desserts!  To top off consistently delicious food, service is always fast and friendly.

Was just passing through SB and decided to stop for dinner. So glad we found this place!!!! Truly THE most amazing Indian food I've ever had in my life -- delicious flavors, just the right amount of spice, and high quality. Had the masala w/tofu (incredible), dal of the day (life changing, never liked lentils until I had this), and naan (so soft and yummy). The metal plates and copper serve ware felt super authentic and unique too, I'd never experienced that before. Staff was super friendly.

An all around unexpectedly amazing dinner, can't wait until we're in town again to come by for more!

I love Barbuzzo for great food and service!

It gets crowded on weekend nights so definitely make a reservation in advance. The inside seating is pretty dark so I was not a fan of that. Thankfully my friend and I sat outside so I like how there's that option. Unfortunately, all the tables felt really small so we had to hold our plates to eat which was inconvenient. Our table had barely enough room for our four ordered items.

We ordered the Charred Local Broccoli, Wood Oven King Oyster Mushrooms, Grilled Spanish Octopus, and House Made and Fennel Sausage. Highly recommend the broccoli, and meat dishes. 

Our waiter Shane was super friendly, welcoming and knowledgeable about the menu. I will definitely come back here again.

Beautiful 2nd floor cafe view of New Orleans with the best breakfast in town. I recommend the fried oysters eggs Benedict. I have tried grits before and didn't care for them, but these are delicious! Love this place and will make it a regular stop when in the Big Easy!
Great breakfast and very convenient. We have ate here twice. The biscuits and gravy is good.

I ordered food last Sunday for lunch 
Packing was good and curbside pickup was on time 
But Dint get garlic bread for main menu item 
And house salad  was spoiled!! 
Disappointed
Just realized my order would of been cheaper going thru Uber easy ordering elsewhere and having it delivered too. Place is overpriced.

I haven't been here in awhile so I wasn't sure what to expect under new management; however, the service and food were amazing on a busy Friday night. My stylist and I ordered the crab cake entree and everything was delicious. Mike B. was our awesome waiter  who was very attentive throughout the night. Because of you, I'll be back.
Fantastic service, BBQ was awesome and sides are wonderful, nothing but a solid BBQ spot
First time. Great customer service. My salad was delicious and my brother liked his burger. No complaints

Disappointed! The fired rice for $15 was bland, and looked more like white rice than fried rice. The seafood hot n sour soup was blah. I ordered their delivery and they didn't put forks or spoons(delivery to hotel) or even sauce.

Another new location and as amazing as the others. Highly recommend as the food is absolutely delicious and prepared fresh. Such an adorable spot and closer to the university when visiting my baby girl. Staff exceptionally attentive and professional. Everyone of them are so friendly. Will definitely be back. They even have an added outside area for dining during Covid. Followed all protocol for Covid and place was super clean.
Still a 5 star rating because love the food and drinks here! And service is top notch too. Such a fun place right in the heart of the city.

Back to 5 stars. Can't resist singing my heart out about how special this place is. It's an institution for sure, and well worth the hour+ drive. We decided we'll be making weekly bagel runs here. It's that serious. Thanksgiving meal stuff was organized super duper well. Can't wait to dig into it tomorrow. Re pricing - $125 is a steal!
I love this place, it is my husband's and my go to spot. Everything we have tried has been amazing. Always great service!

I am a Korean who lived in Korea for 30 years and this is the most authentic restaurant in Saint Louis. 
I highly recommend the place to American and Korean! You will taste the soul of Korea.

My husband and I picked up takeout on a Thursday evening. We shared the Yakiniku and Saginaki po-boys. They were excellent! The service process was quick and they brought it out to the car. The only thing was, when we got home the bottom bread was mushy and soaked through. Next time, I will ask for the bread and filling separate for transport. I am excited to try their soft shell crab po boy! #yelplove

This is one of those random places in Ybor I love going to when I go day drinking. I love sitting in their outdoor space sipping on their margaritas and listening to live music while enjoying the Florida weather. They have decent food, but I only tend to order small items, like their chips and salsa or their chicken tortilla soup (it's amazing!). This place is really chill and I think that's what I like most. It's nice to sit, hang out, and not feel rushed. Not only fo they have typical Mexican food and drinks, but they also carry local craft beer and domestics so there is something for everyone. Service has never been an issue of the many times I've gone. If you're a no frills type of person and don't need fancy decor or anything over the top, then you'll likely enjoy this place, it's just a fun bar in Ybor.

Note: they offer all you can eat fajitas!

I'll start by saying this.  Manny's is better than Joey's but not as good as Five Points.  The restaurant had plenty of seating (take a note there Joey's) and people taking your order weren't yelling at you about what you wanted.  The pizza was delicious and cooked perfect.  The calzone was equally delicious.  The worst part is it's located downtown where you have to find and pay for parking but not bad for an occasional visit.

This a Tampa staple for a reason! Not only is everything delicious but all of the staff were so friendly and helpful. We went on a weekday morning knowing that it can get pretty packed. This location doesn't have any tables but we just ate al fresco on the curb ha. Also their cafe con leche is no joke, it kept me caffeinated for hours!!! Obviously don't leave without their Cuban bread, no matter if it's plain, toasted with butter, of fully loaded as a breakfast sandwich it's freaking delicious!

The food was excellent! The bad part was the service. They took forever to come and check on us, take our orders. Then the waiter added the 10% gratuity when it definitely wasn't earned. The food is good but they need to work on their customer service.

We stopped for lunch and ordered our drinks.
After we were served our drinks (a Coke and an unsweet tea) and ordered a Po'Boy they told us they have no bread.

It was our last day in town for my wife's birthday.

We decided to go somewhere else.

They charged us $6.00 for two drinks we did not drink!!

Great customer service!!

Keep walking. There are lots of better options in town.

I had an amazing time here on Friday night!    It's a New York/Chicago-esque caberet experience right in the heart of Fishtown!  

Located right next to Barcade, Fabrika is in a large, beautiful 2-floor warehouse.  It has a sophisticated, yet chill vibe and you really felt transported into another city.  Several people at my table mentioned that you felt that you were in NYC or Chicago rather than Philly.    

We arrived at 8pm, but stayed past midnight for the entertainment, which begins around 10/10:30pm.  

The food was great and of high quality, done in a Mediterranean style and the prices were very reasonable, considering that there is no cover charge and that there's also entertainment involved.   In fact, even if were no entertainment, the prices are still reasonable for the food alone.  

The highlight of the evening of course is the caberet show, with a variety of acts.   You have some low-key dancers, dressed up in various costumes, and they performed well. This escalated later to a drag show, pole dancers, a contortionist, and singers.   My favorite act of the night is the violinist, who really worked the crowd and put on a fun show.   All in all, everyone was very good.

Highly recommended and I'd definitely go back!

What a wonderful experience at Pasta Pomodoro. Owner makes excellent food for us. We are vegetarian and I have been going to their restaurant ever seems they open that restaurant. Egg plant parmigiana and stuff eggplant is always my favorite food.

Live it

Do NOT order from this location if you want your food delivered on time, delivered in an edible form, or to have a pleasant experience. You'd think a chain restaurant would have decent customer service, but let me tell you otherwise. 

My order ETA was 40-50 minutes. I ordered some of their wings, as a friend had mentioned that they were tasty. At the 1 hour mark, I called to ask what the issue was, and the guy answering said that my order had just been prepared and should be picked up soon. Okay, no sweat, only roughly 15 min behind schedule when it would be delivered right?

Well I was wrong. I called again at the 1.5 hour mark, a bit irked, and was RUDELY told that the order is on its way and they were busy. Learn some manners please if you are going to work in the service industry. 

Finally, the order arrived at the 2 hour mark, by which point I had already made and eaten my backup lunch, and thank god I had because the food was cold. Seething, I figured they'd at least refund me for an order that took more than twice the time to arrive and that came cold. 

I called back, and was told I was being transferred to the manager. He was rude, curt, and unsympathetic. He didn't offer anything, and kept insinuating that it was my fault the wings were cold. I kept thinking, how does that make sense? After wasting my time for 5 min, I asked for a refund and he refused. Once again, extremely rudely. I hung up and quickly tossed out the mediocre and cold wings. I would rather spend

This was an AMAZING date night! Great food, amazing service, 10/10! Clean, COVID guidelines maintained. They answer any questions you have, suggestions, everything! The food is from scratch and the place is beautiful! Richard, the host was exceptional! Always made sure everything was okay. The staff is polite and they really tend to your needs. Definitely recommend and will definitely be back! 
PS we ordered so many things and we loved them all!

I give 1 stars because 0 isn't an option. I stopped by on a Monday night around 8:00 and the place was dead, like 5 tables seated dead. I was seated promptly as expected, but then I sat there, and sat there. 5 minutes turned to 10 and 10 turned to 15. I got up and walked out, never laid eyes on a server or a manager.  I never have this problem at the Chicago locations.

I would not recommended this dominos to anyone to order. I tried to place my order online 5 times and every time it said that there was a error and to contact the store if this persists . After attempting one more time I contacted the store and spoke with a lady who told me with attitude to call back because there was a bad connection. The second person who I spoke to said the deal was only online even after I told him I was unable to process the order I asked to speak to his manager. After speaking to his manager she was rude to me and and told me that she guesses she can override it. The employees at this location are very unprofessional and rude and next time I will be taking my business elsewhere.

I went to Culver's today not having super high hopes. BUT the mushroom Swiss burger was absolutely amazing!! I also got the chili cheddar fries which were good as well. Plus the staff was super friendly at this location. Thanks guys!!

Truly authentic Japanese food that tastes great and won't break the bank, served by some of the kindest people I've ever met.  Their tonkotsu ramen is perfect--rich, flavorful, sticky, everything you expect a tonkotsu broth to be.  If you like it spicy, ask your server to bring some La-Yu to the table.  There are plenty of sushi options to choose from, both traditional and "Americanized", like the California or Philly roll.  I'm not a sushi fan myself, but I've never seen or heard that it's anything less than fresh and tasty.  My grandmom absolutely LOVES the vegetable spring rolls.  Get dessert while you're there, too--any of their maccha offerings (the cheesecake, creme brulee, etc.) are a wonderfully light and sweet way to end a meal.

UPDATE: I just wanted to update my review since I've seen some nasty reviews on here since.  I go to Musashi at least once a month, and I've NEVER had any poor service--especially not from Keiko.  She is always a delight whenever she's serving or managing.  The food is always delicious, and in the two years that I've been going here it's always been the same great quality.

Also, another tip I've just recently discovered--if you get the Beef Teriyaki Kushi, ask for a side of spicy mayo to dip them in.  Such a great combination!
Amazing!! Such good taste and awesome prices too. Did the order ahead/drive up option with COVID and was very quick and easy.

What a great vibe! Pulled in as I drove by and heard the music wafting out to the car.

The claim to fame here is their dedication to locally sourced fisherman with fish and shrimp from the Gulf.

Check out the chalk board to see the fresh  local catches as well as non seafood and veggie options. 

I tried the red snapper grilled w a citrus blend on a plate w red beans, rice and freshly made coleslaw. My cohort in crime tried the grilled shrimp.

The snapper had a perfect crisp "char" on top (see pic) with a light lemon citrus flavor. The red beans and rice were good and complimented the snapper well. 

The grilled shrimp were a bit tough (over cooked) but not bad at all, with a nice mild flavor that went well with the crunchy coleslaw.

The bartender though - Bri - was an amazing ambassador for this first time visitor. I had a smoky drink reminiscent of a speakeasy call to the past aptly named "Blood Money" while my fellow diner sipped on an "Abandon Ship" - 2 GREAT and wildly different drinks.

Swing by, enjoy a bite of local goodness and  taste the flavors of Tampa Bay.
Tina was my waitress! I'm visiting from Dallas, Texas! The food was absolutely delicious! Service was amazing! I recommend this restaurant for everyone visiting!

Just had lunch at this place.  Absolutely delicious. We were seated immediately and our order as well.  The food is piping hot when served.  I had the best Cobb salad ever! This is high quality food. I would compare the food quality to Top Chef.  I also had the Spanish Bean soup, never had anything like it.  So good! We also ordered the schnitzel sandwich with tots. My goodness, Perfection!  The beer menu is out of this world. I wish I could have tasted them ALL.  I'll be back for more!
Incredible food and might have been the best Bloody Mary I've had. Awesome patio too.  They make all their own dressings and sauces, even the ketchup, which was awesome. Can't recommend it enough.

Terrible customer service! Got a takeout ordered a steak with a sweet potato. Got the steak but no sweet potato called took me 10 minutes to actually talk to someone who informed me he needed a manager I waited another 10 minutes! Then gave up cause I had better things to do with my life than waiting for someone! Useless! Never going there again!
We love Sang Kee Asian Bistro. Gets crowded on Friday nights. Worth the wait though. Owners are very friendly.

I specifically asked for no onions, as the receipt shows. As soon as they almost threw the bag into my car window I smelled onions. When I got home, there were indeed onion. Terrible customer service.
Crappy good but great location if you want to hang out on campus.  I have had better frozen pizza or even gas station pizza.  Nice waitress though.  Go for the location not for the food.

Decent donuts. I sampled 6 donuts. I'd only go back for 1 of them again. That one was the oreo. It was a donut stuffed with an oreo and oreo cream. My wife got a Boston cream and it barely had any cream.

This donut shop also does the thing I hate most about donut shops. They open at X time and close when they sell out. This is such a bad business decision. Donuts are cheap to make. If they just kept a steady inventory than I'd actually want to go back and try them again. But it is to hard getting there right when they open. So I'll probably never go back.

A brewery setup in an old church. They've kept it pretty true to its original architecture on the outside and inside. It's a very cool and open space. Its a lot bigger than I expected on the inside with a bar area and plenty of tables. Parking is a little tricky but can usually find something on the street. 

I got a beer flight so I could try a few different flavors. I chose the 3 house beers and the kangaroo  double. I really liked the blonde and the ipa. The kangaroo beer had nice flavors too. 

We ordered the soft pretzels and cheese as a snack but they have a full food menu too. As it got closer to dinner time so many people were there just to eat. The food smelled really good!

Firstly I love restaurants with rooftop dining areas, so this was a win for me. I am very picky on portion size and presentation of dishes and The Banks Drinkery & Kitchen did not disappoint. There was more than enough food and the ambiance was so perfect. I recommend for dates and even just watching the game at the downstairs bar. I am here about once a week now and it is always perfection.

One of my favorite places to visit in Reno for good Sui Mai! Their mushroom sui Mai is so delicious. The flavoring is unmatched! I love getting two orders of the sui Mai and a dozen pork buns and bring them home for the guys on football Sunday . It's a huge hit!!!!! Best sui Mai in town, hands down.

I didn't know I liked oysters until I came here. Do yourself a favor and get one of each of the oysters available. Pair then with the cocktail that they light on fire and then sit back and take in the amazing interiors!

I've been ordering from Win Wah for about 5 years now. I typically order online. When ordering online, it gives you the option to leave a tip. I always leave 15%.

As I was ordering online recently (today), I accidentally selected the cash option when I put my order through. Since I didn't have enough cash to cover the bill, I called the restaurant, explained what happened and provided them with my order number and credit card information.

When my food arrived, I walked down and signed the receipt. I did not put a tip on the receipt as I already left one online (which I have done hundreds of times). The delivery guy proceeded to YELL exclaiming "NO TIP?!?" while belligerently and obnoxiously pointing at the tip line on the receipt. I again explained the situation and reiterated I left a 15% tip online AS I ALWAYS DO but the woman who took my card information must not have reflected the tip on the receipt (which was confirmed she did not). Not my fault but apparently he didn't understand a word that was coming out of my mouth and continued to yell "I NEED MONEY". Uh, yea jacka$$, don't we all. How dare their employees treat their customers, let alone long-time loyal customers in such an egregious manner. It's a disgrace. I called the restaurant and advised (in a calm and polite manner mind you) them of the encounter. So naturally, they were defensive and impolite.

I can't even comprehend this situation. Like what and how. And the most hysterical/ironic part of it is, I ended

Love this place. It's come a long way from meager beginnings in the 90's, it was a converted House. Its Still cheap $8 for cal if. roll. Menu is larger and everything looks so good. free hot green tea. Wheelchair accessible.

Visited this location on Friday November 6,2020 unfortunately I was 100% disappointed. 
Wrong appetizer was served no biggie it happens, waitress brought over an alcoholic beverage which we did not order along with this my husbands dinner was served to him lukewarm which is not acceptable. The pasta was hard, not enough sauce. We asked for a manager he took the dinner plate 32 minutes later a new pasta plate was brought to our table in the exact same condition. We decided to order desert waitress returned to the table 15 minutes later stated the desert  is still frozen we should choose something else. At this point we asked for the check and decided to leave $90 wasted. 
Absolutely furious and disappointed in this place.

I can't really review their food since I've only heard their food was good but haven't been able to try it yet due to their horrible phone system,  we've either been hung up on or the phone just rings and rings or we can't get even get through at all.  Plus you can't even order online not even through postmates or Door dash

We ordered here for Xmas day dinner and definitely feel rewarded for breaking from our norm! Order was placed the millennial way: online. We specified very little spice, as they do bring the heat! Not enough to be unpleasant or anything, but enough to maybe clear the sinuses and break a slight sweat. 

My entree was beef rendang. The beef was tender and surprisingly still a bit pink. For me, the rarer the better and this is hard feat to pull off in a stew. Another delightful surprise was they offer a choice of rice: brown, jasmine or fried. I went with brown to try to be a little healthy and because I hate eggs! It was nicely cooked and absorbed the rendang sauce well. 

Boo ordered dumplings and drunken noodles. She enjoyed them both, and said they had some heat despite the "very little spice" request.

One slight disappointment was the satay- the chicken and beef tasted like it was sitting around a while and didn't have much flavor. Oddly sweet. I'd skip this next time. 

We also split a philly roll and ordered a piece of tuna and a piece of salmon sashimi. The fish was fresh despite being Christmas Day, which was a delightful surprise to my cynical brain.  Our cat Alfie also enjoyed his piece of tuna sashimi. We've been to other sushi places where he didn't eat the fish, and we don't typically return to these venues!

Bonus points for the throw-in of a few cans of soda for the brief 5 minute wait upon arrival. Staff was friendly, and parking was ample on the holiday. Like

This is the worst experience I have EVER had with Panera!!!  I love Panera!  I have been eating there for years which is why I went to them the minute I had a party coming up!  It was my mom's 80th birthday and we were picking up PREORDERED (a week ahead) food for her party.  A bus full of 80 plus year olds on our way to Firestone Winery for a picnic.  Not only did this location NOT have my order ready as requested....they showed no sign of it even being placed!  I had the name of the person who I ordered it with and I even called the day BEFORE the party to confirm my order.  The manager in charge was rude, nasty, and disorganized!!  They not only made me 50 minutes late for my Firestone Winery reservation......but the order was wrong and missing a lot of items!!  I was in such a huge hurry to get to the winery (because we were so late) that I didn't look at everything they packed.  I ASSUMED they would make sure they had gotten it right!! Meanwhile....the manager disappeared to the back of the store and I never saw him again.  He was spineless and did nothing to make sure I walked away happy.  I will NEVER use Panera again for an event.  This is why so many businesses are going OUT OF BUSINESS!

This place is BALLER ASF!!! If u want to know how GOD intended the Burger to be for Mankind, go here. If you're afraid of the tasty, delicious, savory red meat boogie man, eat some celery and maybe check to see if you still have a pair. This is one man's vision of a burger oasis in a desert of mediocre fast food fantasy.

Best Chinese food around! I live in Philly and drive to West Chester just for this. High quality Chinese food. My favorite is the General Tso's shrimp. I also have family in the area that exclusively eats at this place because it's their favorite as well.

Overall amazing experience, they were quick to greet us (even though they thought they were late, in which they gave us drinks on the house). Super informative on their dishes, great recommendations. Ask for Scott!! One of the best servers I've ever had :)

Sooooo good! Fresh, fresh, fresh! Really nice and big outdoor seating and not too noisy. Great service.  We got the chorizo nachos, mahi mahi tacos and spicy pork fajitas.   Oh don't forget blthe amazing drinks....we got two Margarita Bloody Marys and two Habinero margaritas. Love this place!
Awesome food. Bun bo hue was so good, love the spicy broth. Decent portion with generous amount of meat. Love the self service concept. Helped myself to a generous heap of sprouts and herbs.
They are very stingy with  cheese, when asked for extra they only put a little more and gave a rude stare.
I love finding a new great place! This is a little gem. I had the shrimp omelette with grits. AMAZING! Nice portions and beautiful presentation. Thanks guys!

This is my second visit to the Clay Oven. The first time I think the food had a lot more flavor, but out of the two times I've gone, I haven't been disappointed. The lunch buffet let's you try several dishes at a reasonable price! I recommend the mango lassi! It's an Indian drink, that tastes AMAZING! Yogurt is used to make this drink so if you're lactose intolerant, beware. All in all, I enjoy this place. The people are very quiet, but they're kind. The ambiance is nice. There's a calm peaceful vibe when walking into the Clay Oven! Try it! You won't regret it!
Love this spot nothing from here I haven't liked. I just wish the mozzarella sticks were cheesier but other than that can't complain!!!

Omg! I loveeeeee this place. I crave the bloody Mary's almost everyday. It's def worth the wait! Our hotel was right around the corner so we put our names on the list early and waited at the hotel until it got closer to our spot. Sooo good!! You cannot go wrong with this place!

I am giving 4 starts because their beer is some of the best in the city. Food wise only had the crispy brussel sprouts and they were average at best and I try sprouts everywhere that has them. Slightly warm and shredded to leaves w few intact pieces of sprout. Atmosphere is so so. Interior is so simple and drab may have been designed by owner's dog.  Where is the imagination?

With the cool weather of late, I have been craving one of my favorite dishes  - something my wife and I would have for lunch at least once a month when we lived in Seattle - authentic Thai Pad Kee Mao (drunken noodles).  And, of course, some panang curry!  

Thus, yesterday, tucked in and binge-watching a new favorite show, I convinced her to let me order Thai for delivery- via Uber Eats.  There were many options, but I went with Lemon Grass because I tried them (in person) about 2 years ago and thought it was delicious.  

We were NOT disappointed!  Ordering was a snap - their Uber Eats menu was simple and easy to navigate.  We had the panang curry with chicken and the pad kee mao - with chicken.  We went with medium heat on both as we weren't sure how heavy their hand is...

From ordering to our door - 50 minutes.  Not bad since they are on W Kennedy and we live in Westchase.  

Food was packaged well and was still nice & hot upon arrival.  The panang curry was velvety, unctuous, with a nice level of heat.  The pad kee mao was awesome!  At "medium", it was on the spicy side - and we like it hot - so good thing we did not elect "Thai hot"!!  Noodles had the right touch of smokiness from a well-seasoned wok.  Silky.  Plenty of chicken & sufficient Thai basil. 

Even better, we have some leftovers for lunch today!

Love the sweet potato noodles and the ginger sauce the best! Citrus chicken was nicely seasoned and cooked perfectly. The brown rice is puffy and sticky and the green beans are still crunchy. Did not take long for food to be ordered and delivered! So good!

Dry. Flavorless. Honestly one of the worst restaurants I've ever been to. We had the shrimp and grits, pork shoulder, chicken, and corn bread and didn't finish any of it. Food was bland with little to no flavor. $33 for pork shoulder with no flavor? Disgusting! I've never not finished a meal while out eating. I was in shock when I took my first bite of pork shoulder and then a bite of chicken from my girlfriends plate. I looked at her and said is this a joke? I would've rather went to McDonalds to eat and I haven't had McDonalds in 10 years. Husk is uninspired and hands down probably the worst meal I've ever had at a restaurant. It really truly sucked. To top it off it had to be almost 80 degrees in the front of the restaurant. So add horrible food to uncomfortable seating. Save yourself and your wallet and literally eat anywhere else. Bad, bad, bad!!

Open late, fresh food and a menu that has something for just about everyone? You tell me why it's taken so long for us to try this place, because I can't think of a reason. 

We were starving after spending the entire evening walking a nearby park and this happened to be the only place open late that also serves salads. We tried the gyro salad and the Greek salad with added gyro meat. Both were perfectly packaged, prepared fresh and included tons of fresh veggies. 

While the parking lot and drive thru are a little tight, the staff was incredibly friendly and quick. We just love having this option instead of trying to scrounge up something at home or settling on typical fast food. 

They also have an extreme amount of seafood on their menu if that's your thing. I feel like they should be doing more advertising! 

Try it out on your next fast food run.

Me and my boyfriend stopped here on the way home from Reno and it was awesome. Saw it on triple D and knew I had to try it. Sad that they didn't have the Pork Belly Bahn Mi they made on the show but oh well. We got a larger Gobbler and a large Portabella and split them. Both were super delicious (and I was stoked that each plate came with two pickles spears, so I ended up with four lol). Price was good. And I felt comfortable and safe there during the pandemic.

Ordered from cozy corner cafe using doordash. Pancakes were pretty badly burnt. Spoke to Zach from cozy corner. He was very apologetic and extremely professional he offered an entree on the house. Thank you.

This place has definitely reopened. The app does not allow me to check in.
I done an online order that was not done correctly. I was concerned when the cashier was not sure of my order. The remake was done quickly and correctly

Always love coming here when in Philly! Giorgio the owner is so sweet, he checks on all the customers to make sure everyone is enjoying their food, it gives a personal touch to the experience. I got their signature sweet potatoe gnocci again, and just like the first experience, I closed my eyes and enjoyed every bite (they are LIFERALLY like pillows, so soft and yummy). Please check this restaurant out if you haven't and live in the Philadelphia area!

You need to go here. Don't think about it, just make the reservation and do it. Everything about this place is fantastic. The drinks, the sides, the (absolutely incredible) salad bar, and of course, the men bringing you meats - it is pretty much nonstop until you can't take anymore. You will undoubtedly leave regretting how much you've eaten, and at the same time be extremely content.

I love Chinese food but I am picky about it. I have ordered multiple times from this restaurant since before the pandemic.  One of the great things about this restaurant is the low delivery fee.  It was one of the reasons why I ordered from here in the first place.  

The first time, the food was great.  My wife fell in love with the fried shrimp and rice and I loved that they make friend rice as requested, which in my case, that means no veggies.  

Another favorite plate of mine is the fried chicken wings with fries and rice.  The food is excellent but one of my problems is with how it is packed.  To close the Styrofoam plate, the plate is stapled.  This caused a problem once because upon opening the plate, the staple landed in the food and I had to eat it carefully until I found the staple.  

Good that doesn't requiring being fried is very inconsistent.  Sometimes, fried food can be just right and crispy.  Other times, it feels burnt, soggy, or hot on the outside with a cold center.  Non-fried foods like lo-mein, is always consistent and delicious.  Because of that, I have a love-hate relationship  with this restaurant.  I got to visit the place out of curiosity and, though it was opened for business, because of the pandemic, the dinning area is being used as a storage for their plates, utensils, and other things the restaurant uses.  You will see boxes on tables.  I asked for napkins and there were none.  Instead, what the lady behind the counter did was go to her truck,

Honestly disappointed. I looked up the hours and checked social media to make sure it was open and I went at 8:40 was closed doors locked lights off..I've tried calling at 9 and 9:30 no one picks up.it's seems you guys are pretty active on social media so hours should be changed on there.
Wait time was not too bad. Parking is terrible. The food is ok.  Customer service was excellent
This place is so good. We've gotten it for both pickup or delivery now a few times and it has been great every time. I highly recommend the falafel wrap, the hummus, and the whipped feta.
